assumptions.adversary_model: post-authentication session hijacker (valid session cookie, no TOTP factor); never passes a step-up challenge; device gate assumed bypassed
assumptions.epsilon_applies_to: each password entry, each TOTP entry (mistyped), and each shared-link access (expired / not shared with the user -> link_fail, as in ztna/views.py shared_file_view)
assumptions.T0_note: 1.0 = TrustScore model default for a new account; 0.7 = degraded start used in R2
